chapter: Highlights, the reunion album and fellow musicians
title: Disappointments and hope for recognition
summary: He wants recognition like Basie and does not plan to retire.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Were there any musical difficulties or disappointments? I mean, were there things that you wished could've, would have happened in your career that didn't quite come together?

Well, that's hard. I had, could be. Things could have been a lot, I wish, well, maybe things going on like you're doing now. It's one thing that hit me that I'm glad is happenning. Things like, well, I wish it could if it's coming to me. Like Basie, just been on it (inaudible). Well, I hope someday that, you know, as long as I'm here, I can get those kind of recognition if it's possible, if it's due me. You know? If not, then I'll, I can understand, you know.

But, I want to stay around as long as I can. I'm not thinking about retiring. This is something like a semi-retirement here for me. See, they'll let me out to go anytime I get ready. But, they'd rather for me to be around a
Okay. Do you see any particular obstacles that keep you from doing any things that you would want to do now?

No, I don't think so. No. I don't think, I figure if it's something that come up to me that I would like to do, I'd just go to the right person and they would work it out. I know, the owner here told me, he said Hawk, whenever you get ready to record something, if you need me, if you run into anything, trouble, just come to me. That's all he told me. He said I'll do just whatever you need. They want me to make a session here at the Concorde, you know, which is a nice idea. I think I'll get around to it one day. And the musicians here, all of them, they want me to. And, they always want me to bring my charts in so they can play cause they said we like to play your charts. You know. So, in the summertime when they have the big band, every Saturday night, they have a big band set after the show. So, I
have been doing other things. But, I said I'll be in there one day, but I haven't gotten to it yet. But, I will.
